claims.claim_ar: حرف الفاء في «فَمَاذَا» يعمل كحرف عطف وتعقيب، يربط ما قبله بما بعده ويؤكد المتابعة والتعقيب على الكلام السابق.
claims.claim_en: The prefixed 'fa' in 'فَمَاذَا' functions as the conjunction 'fa' for connection/ta'qib (linking and following), tying the prior context to the question and stressing continuation/retort.
claims.rhetorical_effect: links the preceding statement to the reproachful question, making the question a direct follow-on (strengthens rhetorical pressure).

claims.claim_ar: حرف الاستفهام «ماذا» هنا يُعالج بوظيفة استنكارية/تحدٍّ؛ أي أنه ليس مجرد طلب معلومة بل استنكار لما طُرح من قرار/مقترح.
claims.claim_en: The interrogative 'mādhā' ('what') is functioning rhetorically as a challenging/reproachful interrogative (analogous to 'istifhām inkārī'), not merely as a neutral question; it puts the addressees on the spot and highlights the absurdity of their counsel.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited source chunk explicitly discusses 'الهمزة للاستفهام الإنكاري' (example: أَفَلا) rather than 'ماذا'; applying the same rhetorical classification to «ماذا» in this verse is an inference from general commentary on interrogatives rather than an explicit comment on this exact particle in the provided chunks.
claims.rhetorical_effect: creates reproach/challenge, pressuring addressees to justify their stance and exposing its implausibility.
